fields.label: Required Hours
fields.description: Minimum worked duration required for Present. This shift value—not a fixed 8 hours—controls attendance. Enter decimal hours here; operational pages display HH:MM.

fields.label: Half Day Hours
fields.description: Minimum net worked duration required for Half Day. Below this shift value attendance is Absent. This value—not a fixed 4 hours—controls attendance. Operational pages display HH:MM.

fields.label: Break Minutes
fields.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Worked duration is First In to Last Out without an automatic break deduction.

fields.label: Early Minutes
fields.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Punch capture is controlled by the maximum capture fields.

fields.label: Late Minutes
fields.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Punch capture is controlled by the maximum capture fields.

fields.label: Maximum Before OT Capture Hours
fields.description: How far before shift start the system may search for this duty's punches. It is a punch-matching safety window, not approved OT. Keep it only as large as operationally necessary to avoid matching another shift's punches.

fields.label: Maximum After OT Capture Hours
fields.description: How far after shift end the system may search for this duty's punches. It is a punch-matching safety window, not approved OT. The attendance remains Pending until this window closes unless processed under an eligible rule.

fields.label: Late Entry Grace Minutes
fields.description: Fixed shifts only. Late Entry is flagged when First In is later than Start Time plus these minutes. This grace does not add worked time or change Required Hours.

fields.label: Early Exit Grace Minutes
fields.description: Fixed shifts only. Early Exit is flagged when Last Out is earlier than End Time minus these minutes. This grace does not add worked time or change Required Hours.
